name: application-modals
title: Modals
description: Modal and dialog components for web applications. Includes simple modals, close buttons, and action modals with responsive, customizable designs.
useWhen: Modal and dialog components for web applications. Includes simple modals, close buttons, and action modals with responsive, customizable designs.
avoidWhen: Avoid modals when a simpler pattern communicates the same content or action.
responsiveBehavior: Modals uses responsive Tailwind utilities where present. Test its layout and interaction states at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths before shipping.
accessibility: Keep semantic HTML structure and visible text labels when adapting this component.
Associate each form field with a visible or programmatic label before production use.
Preserve the component’s semantic HTML when adapting its visual treatment.
